text:
Jordan Li: Handoff — Maya, I'm swapping you on for the 18:00-02:00 PT shift. Quick TL;DR below. Canary v3.2 at 10% on Dedicated. Watch prefetch queue, kv-cache evictions, and p95 text-gen latency. No active incidents.
Maya Patel: Thanks — got it, I'll take watch. I'll be online for the full window.
Jordan Li: Notes: 1) Canary started at 17:10 PT. 2) We saw a p95 tail when seq > 2048, looks like kernel fallback on a3700 nodes. 3) Autoscaler cooldown was bumped to 90s earlier today to stabilize batching. 4) Rolling restart (config reload) is in progress; expected to finish ~20:00.
Priya Kumar: Pinged on PR #1245 (quantization tweak). If that lands, we need to regenerate model index; could add ~30m to rollout. I'll update here once CI passes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam O'Neill: I'll stand up a temporary alert: `p95_latency_textgen > 1500ms for 3m` and `kv_cache.eviction_rate > 5%` and notify channel.
oncall-bot: [automated] Canary deployment v3.2 started by deploy-bot at 2024-11-02T17:10:23Z. Runbook: https://runbooks/internal/rollback-canary
Jordan Li: If you see cache hit rate drop >10% -> run `scripts/kv-rebuild --shard 2` (will warm cache on shard-2). Also watch `prefetch.queue_length` and `prefetch.latency`.
Maya Patel: Quick Q: is any customer pinned to the Dedicated cluster? I want to know risk surface if we rollback.
Jordan Li: Tenant `peakai` is on Dedicated but very low traffic. Locking is off. Only a concern if error rate spikes >1% or p95 skyrockets.
Priya Kumar: FYI logs showed two `AllocateBuffer` fallbacks earlier on gpu7: `WARN runtime: AllocateBuffer fallback to host mem size=1.2G` — might correlate with the seq>2048 regressions.
Sam O'Neill: Added dashboard alerts and a Slack alarm. I'll also add a short-lived grafana panel for `kernel_fallback.count_by_node`.
Maya Patel: Action items for night: 1) I'll monitor p95 + error rate, and escalate if p95 >1500ms or errors >0.5%. 2) Priya to keep an eye on PR #1245 and notify if it merges. 3) Sam to maintain alerts and dashboards. 4) Jordan to hand over dashboard links and runbook pointers.
Jordan Li: Dashboard links: text-gen-canary (https://grafana.internal/d/text-gen-canary), kv-cache-health (https://grafana.internal/d/kv-cache-health), autoscaler-events (https://grafana.internal/d/autoscaler-events). Runbooks: rollback-canary, handle-prefetch-spike. I gave Maya access to the canary dashboard.
Maya Patel: Sounds good. I'll start with a 30m focused check-in cadence then move to hourly if stable. Ping me on this thread if anything odd. :thumbsup:
Priya Kumar: Noted — I'll post CI status here if it changes.
Sam O'Neill: I'll keep an eye on node gpu7. If we see repeated `AllocateBuffer` warnings, we should consider draining that node from the canary pool.
Maya Patel: Acknowledged. Starting watch now.
Jordan Li: Thanks — I'm on standby until 18:10 to answer quick questions, then offline. Good handoff.
